svg.text: External headers export signals and ground. Designated supply rails stay on the board. UART is CMOS, not RS-232.
J7 3.3 V UART0, crossed peer wiring
TX to peer RX, RX to peer TX, and common ground. Require an Ioff-safe peer or keep both ends powered.
Ioff buffers prevent a powered peer from sourcing the unpowered module through UART pins.
No 5 V, RS-232, or supply pin.
J8 Addressable pixel protocol, data only
GP16 remains the onboard pixel. GP17 provides a separate external data output using the same
A 5 V strip needs its own 5 V supply and a power-off-safe level shifter at the strip end. Connect
J8 is keyed data + ground. No strip power is drawn through this board or the USB chain.
D+ and D- are open. Power comes exclusively from the A5 path on sheet 3.
VBUS path on sheet 4. Data and host termination on sheet 5.
Electrical design review / Named nets are joined across sheets / x = intentional NC
